description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (EX00; EX01; EX02; EX03; EX04; EX10; EX11; EX12; EX20; PR00; PR01; PR02; PR03; PR04; PR10; PR11; PR12; PR20; SL01  Received:  14 January 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear extension hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - The proposed 2.47 metre high shared boundary fence with No. 44 Cleveland Avenue shall be erected prior to the completion of construction works and permanently retained.
